sections.what_happened: Overnight Nov 6-7 Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones (137 jet-powered) at Kyiv and surrounding regions in three waves (from ~23:00 Nov 6, ~01:00 and ~03:00 Nov 7). The Pivnichnyi (Northern) Bridge over the Dnipro was hit and closed in both directions (road surface, trolleybus wires, power lines damaged); energy facilities in Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions hit; Kyiv's power, heating and water supply 'extremely difficult' (Klitschko). Russia's MoD on Nov 7 confirmed it targeted the bridge (claiming it facilitated transport of weaponry/military hardware), a Flamingo missile plant, a power station, an electrical substation and an ammunition/explosives plant in the Kyiv region, plus a Zhytomyr substation. Ukraine's Air Force: 149 of 172 drones and 4 ballistic missiles intercepted/suppressed by 09:00. Casualties: AP reports 5 wounded in Kyiv city (incl. a 14-year-old); Business Recorder/Korea JoongAng report 1 killed and 8 wounded across Kyiv + Oblast; Zelenskyy put it at 9 injured incl. 1 child and 1 killed in Kyiv Oblast (1400-01) -- figures conflict across sources and are NOT reconciled. Zelenskyy warned intelligence shows Russia preparing further strikes on energy, Dnipro bridges and civilian infrastructure and urged partners not to delay Patriot interceptors. Abu Dhabi trilateral talks (Ukraine-Russia-US) Tue Nov 10-11 confirmed.
sections.what_verified: AP (T1) via La Nacion + Business Recorder; AFP (T1) via Daily Sabah 'with Agencies'; Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA) via OSNT brief for Air Force figures; Kyiv Independent (T2) via social (Klitschko bridge video). Russia MoD confirmation is a primary-source claim carried by AP/AFP.
sections.what_disputed: Casualty figures conflict: AP 5 wounded in Kyiv city; Korea JoongAng/Business Recorder 1 killed + 8 wounded; Zelenskyy 9 injured incl. 1 child + 1 killed in Kyiv Oblast. Russia's MoD claims the bridge was a legitimate military target (weapons transport) and the strikes hit military-industrial/energy/transport targets -- Ukraine calls the bridge and energy grid civilian infrastructure. Interception claim (4 of 36 ballistic missiles) is Ukraine's Air Force figure, not independently verified.
sections.why_matters: Russia just admitted it hit Kyiv's bridge on purpose -- 36 ballistic missiles, 172 drones, and Moscow says the bridge was moving weapons. Kyiv's lights, heat and water are out as winter bites.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE TO totw-20261107-1400-01 (Kyiv ballistic missile strike) -- Russia's MoD CONFIRMS it targeted the Northern Bridge (claims it moved weapons), a Flamingo missile plant, power station, substation and ammunition plant; Air Force: 172 drones (137 jet-powered) + 36 ballistic missiles, 149 drones and 4 ballistic missiles intercepted; bridge closed both ways, Kyiv power/heating/water 'extremely difficult'

totw_analysis: Our read: Russia just admitted it hit Kyiv's bridge on purpose -- 36 ballistic missiles, 172 drones, and Moscow says the bridge was moving weapons. Kyiv's lights, heat and water are out as winter bites. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Was the Northern Bridge a legitimate military target because it moves weapons -- or is hitting a city's bridge, power, heating and water in freezing weather a war on civilians?
